mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbox ( user_id, session_id, last_read_seq_id, is_pinned, is_muted, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{lastReadSeqId}, #{isPinned}, #{isMuted}, #{updateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_read_seq_id = VALUES(last_read_seq_id), is_pinned = VALUES(is_pinned), is_muted = VALUES(is_muted), update_time = VALUES(update_time)

INSERT INTO inbox ( user_id, session_id, last_read_seq_id, is_pinned, is_muted, update_time ) VALUES
( #{entity.userId}, #{entity.sessionId}, #{entity.lastReadSeqId}, #{entity.isPinned}, #{entity.isMuted}, #{entity.updateTime} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_read_seq_id = VALUES(last_read_seq_id), is_pinned = VALUES(is_pinned), is_muted = VALUES(is_muted), update_time = VALUES(update_time)
